gaps.sentence: The refugees ___ (provide) with blankets and hot meals last night.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + provided. Note the pattern provide somebody WITH something.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't use the meeting room because it ___ (clean) all morning.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was being + cleaned over a period in the past.

gaps.sentence: The company ___ (say) to be on the verge of bankruptcy.
gaps.explanation: It is said that... → The company is said to be... Present simple passive: is said.

gaps.sentence: The fault ___ by the time the auditor arrived.
gaps.explanation: The fixing preceded the arrival: past perfect passive had been + fixed.

gaps.sentence: The decision ___ (announce) at yesterday's press conference.
gaps.explanation: 'Yesterday' signals past simple passive: was + announced.

gaps.sentence: The castle ___ in the twelfth century.
gaps.explanation: A completed past date takes the past simple passive.

gaps.sentence: A cheaper version of the vaccine ___ right now.
gaps.explanation: 'Right now' requires present continuous passive: is being + developed.

gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.
